caption: The drawing depicts a single empty flower pot placed centrally within a lightly outlined rectangular border on a plain, light background. The pot is round and tapers slightly toward the base, with a wider, thick rim at the top. The to surface of the pot is shaded to show depth and an interior, while the exterior is rendered in shades of light brown, tan, and reddish-brown, giving it a mottled, textured appearance that suggests clay or terracotta material. Subtle shadows under the rim and inside the pot, as well as along the sides, give the pot a three-dimensional look. There is a faint shadow cast behind and underneath the pot, indicating a light source from the upper left. The artist’s signature, "Annie B. Johnston," appears in the bottom right corner inside the border.
title: Stoneware Flower Pot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
